Mass (kg) is matter; weight (N) is the gravitational force, W = mg.

walkthroughs.body_html:
When forces on an object are equal and opposite, they cancel out.

A book on a table: gravity pulls down, table pushes up. Forces balance, book stays still.

Balanced forces mean: stationary objects stay still, or moving objects keep the same speed and direction.

If forces don't cancel, there's a resultant force. This makes things change.

Push a trolley with 20 N forward, friction pushes back with 5 N. Resultant = 15 N forward. The trolley speeds up.

Unbalanced forces cause objects to accelerate, slow down, or change direction.

Friction always opposes motion. It can be helpful or annoying.

Helpful: brakes on bikes, grip on shoes.

Unhelpful: slows machines, wastes energy as heat. We use oil to reduce it.

Air resistance is just friction with air - a parachute uses it to slow a skydiver.

mcqs.q: A car drives at a constant speed. What does this tell us about the forces?
options: Forces are unbalanced
Forces are balanced
There are no forces
Friction is zero

mcqs.q: Which would reduce friction between machine parts?
options: Adding sand
Adding rubber
Adding oil
Adding water alone

mcqs.q: Can a device ever be 100 percent efficient?
options: Efficiency above 100 percent is possible if the device extracts ambient energy.
In practice, no — some energy is always transferred to less useful stores (e.g. heat to surroundings).
A well-designed device can be 100 percent efficient by eliminating all friction.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Newton (N)”?
options: Single force equal to all forces combined.
Unequal forces - cause speed or direction change.
Friction from air slowing moving objects.
Unit of force; 1 N pushes 1 kg by 1 m/s every second.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Balanced forces”?
options: Friction force from a fluid (air or water).
Equal forces in opposite directions - no change.
Single force equal to all forces combined.
Friction from air slowing moving objects.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Unbalanced forces”?
options: Friction force from a fluid (air or water).
Unequal forces - cause speed or direction change.
Unit of force; 1 N pushes 1 kg by 1 m/s every second.
Equal forces in opposite directions - no change.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Resultant force”?
options: Unit of force; 1 N pushes 1 kg by 1 m/s every second.
Equal forces in opposite directions - no change.
Single force equal to all forces combined.
Unequal forces - cause speed or direction change.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Drag”?
options: Single force equal to all forces combined.
Equal forces in opposite directions - no change.
Unequal forces - cause speed or direction change.
Friction force from a fluid (air or water).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Air resistance”?
options: Single force equal to all forces combined.
Friction force from a fluid (air or water).
Friction from air slowing moving objects.
